author: U. N. Kim
title: County of Maui extends deadline for student water protection video contest to April 24
text:
The County of Maui Department of Water Supply announced on April 15 that the deadline for its 8th Annual Water Source Protection Video Contest has been extended to April 24, giving Maui County students in grades 7 through 12 more time to participate.
The contest aims to raise awareness among local youth about the importance of protecting water sources and maintaining water quality. Organizers encourage students to create videos centered on this year’s theme, “Ola I Wai – Water is Life.”
Participants are required to submit videos between three and five minutes long in .mp4 format. Each entry must include the name or names of up to four student creators per group. Students are advised to plan their scripts carefully, consider camera and audio placement, and credit any resources used in their projects.
Entries will be evaluated based on creativity, originality, adherence to the theme, accuracy, and production quality. Prizes of up to $350 will be awarded.
Submissions can be mailed or delivered in person to One Main Plaza at 2200 Main St., Suite 102, Wailuku, HI 96793 or submitted electronically via Microsoft 365. Additional information about contest rules and entry forms is available at https://waterresources.mauicounty.gov/224/2026-8th-Annual-Source-Protection-Video -. For general information about the Department of Water Supply, visit www.mauicounty.gov/water .
The extension provides students with additional time for planning and production as they work on raising community awareness about safeguarding vital water resources.
